description: Publish Subscriptions & Social Graph on AT Protocol - turn rsss into an AT-Protocol-native social reader. Reverse the current token-discard OAuth design so the server can write to the user's PDS using granular per-collection scopes (never transition:generic). Publish RSS subscriptions per-feed with explicit consent as space.rsss.feed.subscription records, maintain an rsss-native follow graph (space.rsss.graph.follow) that is independent of Bluesky follows, and recommend follows by intersecting the user's public Bluesky follows with the set of known rsss users. Reverse/aggregation reads use the hosted microcosm Constellation + Slingshot services (configurable base URLs). rsss activity never touches app.bsky.* and never appears in the Bluesky timeline. See tasks/prd-atproto-social.md.

userStories.title: Define rsss lexicons and derived TypeScript types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need formal lexicon definitions so client and server agree on the shape of records written to user repos.
acceptanceCriteria: Add lexicon JSON for space.rsss.feed.subscription (record) with fields: feedUrl (uri, required), title (string), siteUrl (uri, optional), createdAt (datetime, required)
Add lexicon JSON for space.rsss.graph.follow (record) with fields: subject (did, required), createdAt (datetime, required)
Lexicons live in a shared location importable by both client and server (e.g. src/shared/lexicons/)
Export TypeScript types for both records derived from the lexicons, with no hand-duplicated record shapes
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-001 / FR-1. NSID namespace space.rsss.* (reverse DNS of rsss.space). Shared code dir is src/shared/ (e.g. src/shared/schema.ts).

userStories.title: Deterministic subscription rkey helper (TDD)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a stable record key derived from a feed URL so subscription writes are 1:1 with feeds and idempotent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a pure helper that canonicalizes a feed URL and derives a deterministic record key valid for the AT Protocol record-key charset
The same feed URL always yields the same rkey; different URLs yield different rkeys
Write failing tests first (TDD) covering canonicalization, rkey stability, and charset validity
Tests pass
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD FR-9 / Technical Considerations (deterministic rkeys). Pure logic in src/shared/. Consumed by US-009 (publish).

userStories.title: Request granular OAuth scopes at login (not transition:generic)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to grant rsss only the specific permissions it needs, so logging in cannot let rsss touch the rest of my repo or my Bluesky posts.
acceptanceCriteria: OAuth authorization request scope is exactly: atproto repo:space.rsss.feed.subscription repo:space.rsss.graph.follow
The request does NOT include transition:generic or any app.bsky.* scope
The client metadata document advertises the same scope set
A code comment documents that existing logged-in users must re-consent on next login because the scope set changed
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-002 / FR-2. src/server/auth/oauth.ts currently sets scope: 'atproto' (~line 340). Also update the served client-metadata document.

userStories.title: Persist OAuth tokens and DPoP key pair per DID on exchange
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to retain the user's tokens and DPoP key so the server can write to their PDS later, reversing the current discard-everything design.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful OAuth exchange, persist access token, refresh token, token endpoint, PDS service endpoint, and the DPoP private key (as JWK) in the user's Durable Object, scoped to that DID
Tokens and keys are stored server-side only and are never included in any response sent to the browser
No tokens or DPoP keys are ever logged
Update the token-discard comment in src/server/auth/oauth.ts to reflect that we now call the PDS, including the security rationale
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-003 / FR-3, FR-4. oauth.ts already has restoreDPoPKeyPair + token-discard comments (lines ~7, ~530). User DO is src/server/durable-objects/index.ts.

userStories.title: DPoP proof JWT helper (TDD)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to generate DPoP proof JWTs bound to the stored key so PDS requests are authenticated on the Workers runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a helper that builds a signed DPoP proof JWT for a given HTTP method, URL, optional server nonce, and access-token hash, using the stored DPoP JWK
The proof carries correct htm, htu, jti, iat (and nonce/ath when provided) claims and the public JWK in the header
Write failing tests first (TDD) verifying claim structure and that the signature verifies with the public key
Tests pass
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-003/US-004 / FR-3. Reuses key material persisted in US-004. Must use WebCrypto (Cloudflare Workers runtime).

userStories.title: Token refresh routine (DPoP-bound)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to refresh an expired access token using the refresh token plus a DPoP proof and persist the rotated tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: A refresh routine exchanges an expired access token at the token endpoint using the refresh token and a DPoP proof (US-005 helper)
It handles the use_dpop_nonce challenge by retrying once with the server-provided nonce
Rotated access and refresh tokens are persisted back to the DO (US-004 storage)
On unrecoverable failure it returns a typed error indicating re-auth is required
No token material is logged
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-003 / FR-3, FR-15. Depends on US-004 storage and US-005 DPoP helper.

userStories.title: PDS write client (putRecord / createRecord / deleteRecord)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-side helper that performs DPoP-signed record writes against a user's PDS, refreshing tokens transparently on 401.
acceptanceCriteria: Helper supports com.atproto.repo.putRecord, com.atproto.repo.createRecord, and com.atproto.repo.deleteRecord with DPoP proofs bound to the stored key (US-005)
On a 401 / use_dpop_nonce / expired-token response it refreshes (US-006) or retries with the server nonce once, then replays the write
On unrecoverable auth failure it returns a typed reconnect-your-account error the caller can map to UX
Errors are reported via the existing reportError path without leaking token material
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-004 / FR-6, FR-11, FR-15. Decide @atproto/api vs extend hand-rolled code (must run on Workers). Reuse/extend src/server/middleware/rate-limit.ts for backoff.

userStories.title: Track per-feed publish state in the user DO
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to know which feeds a user has published so the UI can reflect it and writes stay idempotent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add per-feed publish columns to the user DO feeds table: published (bool), rkey, publishedAt, last publish error (nullable)
Add a guarded migration following the existing migrateAddXxx pattern (bump USER_DO_MIGRATION_VERSION) that does not break existing data or sync
Publish state is exposed to the client through the existing server-authoritative sync path, not a new ad-hoc channel
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-A1 / FR-10. DO migrations live in src/server/durable-objects/index.ts (migrateAddItemImageMetadata etc; USER_DO_MIGRATION_VERSION). Record/shared types in src/shared/schema.ts.

userStories.title: Publish a subscription record on toggle-on
userStories.description: As a user, when I enable sharing for a feed, that feed appears as a record in my PDS repo.
acceptanceCriteria: A server endpoint writes a space.rsss.feed.subscription record via putRecord (US-007) using the deterministic rkey (US-002)
Re-publishing the same feed updates in place rather than duplicating (idempotent on rkey)
On success, published / rkey / publishedAt are persisted (US-008) and synced
On failure, state stays unpublished and a re-auth-required error routes the user to reconnect
Tests pass (publish path and idempotency)
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-A3 / FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-9. Per-feed opt-in only; never write a record without an explicit per-feed action.

userStories.title: Unpublish on toggle-off or unsubscribe
userStories.description: As a user, when I disable sharing or unsubscribe from a feed, its record is removed from my PDS repo.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggling off calls deleteRecord (US-007) for that feed's rkey and clears publish state
Unsubscribing from a feed that was published also deletes its record, leaving no orphaned records
Deleting an already-absent record is treated as success (idempotent)
Tests pass (idempotent delete and unsubscribe cleanup)
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-A4 / FR-6, FR-7, FR-8. Hook into the existing unsubscribe path in the user DO.

userStories.title: Reconcile published state with the repo
userStories.description: As a user, I want the share indicators to reflect what is actually in my repo even if a write previously failed or I used another client.
acceptanceCriteria: A reconcile routine lists space.rsss.feed.subscription records via public com.atproto.repo.listRecords and aligns local publish state to it
Drift (record exists but state says unpublished, or vice versa) is corrected without losing the user's intent where it is unambiguous
Reconcile runs on a sensible trigger (e.g. opening the feeds view after reconnect) and is rate-limited
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-A5 / FR-16. listRecords against the user's own repo is public (no auth). Reuse/extend src/server/middleware/rate-limit.ts.

userStories.title: Share on Bluesky toggle per feed (UI)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clear per-feed control to publish or unpublish that single subscription, so nothing is shared without a deliberate action.
acceptanceCriteria: Each feed in the feeds view has a toggle/affordance labelled for sharing to Bluesky
The toggle reflects current published state on load (on = published)
Toggling shows an in-progress state and a published/failed result
In-place state changes use @preact/signals with sequential signal writes wrapped in batch; any navigation uses <a href>, never onClick that sets the URL
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-A2. UI in src/client/routes/feeds.ts + feeds.css. Reuse @substrate-system/check-box/button. Memory: links not buttons for navigation.

userStories.title: Consent and privacy copy for publishing
userStories.description: As a user, I want to understand that publishing puts my subscription on the public AT Protocol network before I do it.
acceptanceCriteria: First publish (or a nearby info affordance) explains: records are written to your own PDS, are public on the AT Protocol network, do not appear in your Bluesky timeline, and can be removed
Copy follows UX-writing conventions; no font size below 1rem; colors use existing CSS variables
CSS changes are scoped to this feature only
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.notes: PRD US-A6. Reuse @substrate-system/dialog. Colors from _variables.css / _vars.css. Do not touch unrelated CSS.

userStories.title: Known-rsss-user registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a registry of DIDs that use rsss so the app can offer follows and discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful login, the user's (did, handle) and optional avatar is recorded in a small login-derived registry
Registry lookups can answer is DID X an rsss user? and which of this set of DIDs are rsss users?
No PII beyond DID/handle/avatar is stored in the registry
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-B1 / FR-12. Store in a singleton DO SQLite or D1 (Open Question: pick per existing deployment/migration tooling). Authoritative source for our own user base.

userStories.title: Configurable microcosm services client (Constellation + Slingshot)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a client for the hosted Constellation and Slingshot services with configurable base URLs so a self-hosted microcosm-rs can be swapped in without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Base URLs for Constellation and Slingshot are read from config (env / wrangler.jsonc vars), defaulting to constellation.microcosm.blue and slingshot.microcosm.blue
Client exposes Constellation getBacklinks / getDistinct / getBacklinksCount (collection space.rsss.graph.follow, path .subject) and Slingshot record + identity reads
Every request sends a descriptive User-Agent identifying rsss
Requests degrade gracefully (typed error or empty result) when a service is unavailable
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-B3/US-B4 / FR-17, Technical Considerations. Read-only index/caches; PDS records remain canonical. Tolerate indexing latency.

userStories.title: Follow / unfollow an rsss user (server endpoint)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to follow another rsss user so I can see their published subscriptions, without affecting my Bluesky follows.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint writes a space.rsss.graph.follow record (subject = target DID, TID rkey) via createRecord (US-007); unfollow deletes it
The write does NOT create or modify any app.bsky.graph.follow record
Follow is idempotent (re-follow does not duplicate); the server may optimistically reflect a new follow in DO state before Constellation indexes it
Tests pass (idempotency and no app.bsky write)
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-B2 / FR-8, FR-11. Followers are served by Constellation (US-018), not a home-grown edge index. The follow button UI is added in US-017 and US-021.

userStories.title: Profile route - view an rsss user's published subscriptions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view another user's shared subscriptions so I can decide whether to follow or subscribe to the same feeds.
acceptanceCriteria: A new profile route reads the target's space.rsss.feed.subscription records via Slingshot (US-015), falling back to public listRecords against the target PDS
Each listed feed offers a one-action subscribe-for-myself affordance
A follow/unfollow button (US-016) reflects current follow state
Handles/DIDs resolve to a display name + avatar; empty and error states are handled
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-B3 / FR-13. New route under src/client/routes/. Reads are public (no auth or scope required).

userStories.title: Following / followers route
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see who I follow on rsss and who follows me.
acceptanceCriteria: Following lists the subjects of my space.rsss.graph.follow records
Followers is answered via Constellation backlinks targeting my DID (getBacklinks/getDistinct, collection space.rsss.graph.follow, path .subject); counts use getBacklinksCount
UI tolerates Constellation indexing latency (eventual consistency) and degrades gracefully if the service is unavailable
Counts and lists paginate or cap sensibly for large graphs
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-B4 / FR-12, FR-17. Uses the US-015 Constellation client.

userStories.title: Read the user's public Bluesky follows
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the user's existing public Bluesky follows to compute recommendations, using only public data.
acceptanceCriteria: Server fetches the user's follows via the public appview app.bsky.graph.getFollows by DID, paginating as needed
No app.bsky.* OAuth scope is requested and no write to the Bluesky graph occurs
Results are cached briefly to avoid hammering the appview
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-C1 / FR-14. Public unauthenticated read; needs neither the user's tokens nor any scope.

userStories.title: Compute recommendations
userStories.description: As a user, I want suggestions of people I already follow on Bluesky who also use rsss.
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendations = the user's Bluesky follows (US-019) intersected with the rsss registry (US-014), minus people the user already follows on rsss
Each result includes handle, display name, avatar, and optionally a count of their shared feeds
Tests pass (intersection and exclusion logic)
Typecheck and lint pass (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint)
userStories.notes: PRD US-C2 / FR-14.
